status: Final-source full regression (1100 tests, 223 suites, zero failures/errors, one browser skip), six Hub tests, real TLS join regression, serial component comparison and fresh native workflow passed locally. New hosted validation and full qualification pending.
scope: WorldVoxels.History shares compact immutable whole-cell segments between CellReplay, staged authority, live World and root snapshots. Ordinary records stay direct. Group masks, immutable overrides and owner-token cell indexes preserve exact Map order and independent forks. Uniform cells share a cached Edit. Existing file/protocol layouts, logical record counts, geometry/model/chunk limits and cancellation/authority gates remain unchanged. This is bulk history compaction, not complete region-backed persistence or city support. Join capture now keeps a constant-root compact History snapshot; delta comparison checks both current and removed snapshot rows, including unchanged clear plus removed final leaf. Ready-phase comparison still scans rows under authority lock and remains a large-world performance gate.

focused.scope: Before the join audit change; History implementation unchanged since this run.

component.method: Exact-parent WorldVoxels and nested classes rebuilt separately against the same dependencies needed by History; the changed server join consumer is not exercised by this component probe. Same public probe, isolated JVMs, serial baseline then current. Three warmups and 20 measured samples per single-cell fixture/mode. Seeded fragmented fixture has 4096 LED leaves plus clear, not the required maximum-limit package. Independent LinkedHashMap rows verify ordered install/scan/snapshot checksums outside timing. ThreadMXBean measures current-thread allocation. Instrumentation sums unique reachable instance/array shallow sizes including shared values once within replay plus two histories. It excludes source geometry, active chunks, undo, players, class metadata and other owners; this is not whole-world or peak heap/RSS. Ordinary 512-cell storage and legacy-style per-row history measured separately. Reflection traverses synthetic graphs only. Source and dependency class fences verified before/after.
component.tradeoffs: Scans materialize transient keys/edits; measured timings/allocation are in summaries. Ordinary 512-cell graph grows 228488 -> 232616 bytes; uniform model combined graph grows 1328 -> 1352 bytes. Masks retain bounded original cell rows until fully removed/replaced. Legacy loads and eager World/render/join-delta scans still need migration. No universal speed/memory or whole-world peak memory claim.
